name: Gamer's Dream
source:
What is every fan's wildest dream come true? Meeting their waifu in real life! Join our futanari heroine, a devoted gamer and comic junkie, experience the entirely unexpected. After returning home from university, she seeks some much-needed relaxation. As luck would have it, fate intervened in the form of an extraordinary circumstance: the one she had long dreamt of materialized right before her eyes, in her very own room!

[From [url=https://marlisstudio.itch.io/gamersdream]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
每个粉丝最狂热的梦想成真，会是什么模样？当然是在现实中见到自己的“老婆”！跟随这位热衷游戏与漫画的双性女主角，经历一场完全意想不到的奇遇。从大学回到家后，她只想好好放松一下。没想到，命运以一种非同寻常的方式介入：她朝思暮想的那个人，竟然就在自己的房间里，出现在了眼前！

[摘自[url=https://marlisstudio.itch.io/gamersdream]itch.io[/url]]
